SECTION 1
* Sajid Javid agrees with the claim made in a news article that it is very hard for young people today to buy a house because prices are high and bank loans are hard to get.
* The author of the letter is frustrated because older generations criticize their spending habits, even though saving enough to buy a house seems nearly impossible.
* Many young people feel they might never be able to own a home. Instead, they see their future as continually renting and being judged for their financial choices.
* The author mentions that there are supposed big discounts for people under 25, but in reality, they often receive lower wages compared to older workers for the same work.
* Young workers often earn very little, and jobs can be unstable, which makes it even harder to save or plan for the future.
